description: This file contains a suite of advanced unit tests for the Orleans task scheduler. It defines the OrleansTaskSchedulerAdvancedTests_Set2 class with multiple test methods verifying scheduling behavior, task execution order, continuation handling, concurrency, and activation workflows within the Orleans distributed framework.

classes.name: OrleansTaskSchedulerAdvancedTests_Set2
classes.description: A test class providing comprehensive tests for the Orleans task scheduler, focusing on task execution order, continuation, concurrency, activation, and scheduling integrity.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources by disposing the logger factory.

methods.name: ActivationSched_SimpleFifoTest
methods.description: Tests simple FIFO behavior of activation scheduling where two tasks are expected to execute in order.

methods.name: ActivationSched_NewTask_ContinueWith_Wrapped
methods.description: Verifies correct task continuation and scheduler context propagation when wrapping tasks within the scheduler.

methods.name: ActivationSched_SubTaskExecutionSequencing
methods.description: Ensures sub-tasks execute serially in the expected sequence within the scheduler.

methods.name: ActivationSched_ContinueWith_1_Test
methods.description: Tests chained continue-with tasks and their execution order within the scheduler.

methods.name: ActivationSched_WhenAny
methods.description: Verifies behavior of Task.WhenAny with multiple tasks scheduled under the custom scheduler.

methods.name: ActivationSched_WhenAny_Timeout
methods.description: Checks timeout behavior of Task.WhenAny when some tasks are delayed or blocked.

methods.name: ActivationSched_WhenAny_Busy_Timeout
methods.description: Ensures that WhenAny with busy (infinite loop) tasks times out correctly.

methods.name: ActivationSched_Task_Run
methods.description: Tests Task.Run behavior and execution context within the scheduler, including continuation.

methods.name: ActivationSched_Task_Run_Delay
methods.description: Verifies that Task.Run with delays behaves correctly under the scheduler.

methods.name: ActivationSched_Task_Delay
methods.description: Tests delay scheduling and continuation within the scheduler.

methods.name: DoDelay
methods.description: Helper method to await a delay with scheduler context assertions.

methods.name: ActivationSched_Turn_Execution_Order_Loop
methods.description: Stress test to verify that turns are executed serially and in order over many chains.

methods.name: ActivationSched_Test1
methods.description: Runs a specific test scenario involving activation and context switching.

methods.name: ActivationSched_Test1_Bounce
methods.description: Runs Test1 with a bounce to thread pool option.

methods.name: Run_ActivationSched_Test1
methods.description: Internal method executing a test involving activation, scheduling, and optional thread bounce.

methods.name: LogContext
methods.description: Logs current task scheduler and context information for debugging.
